categories.hint.bauamt: Responsible for building applications and building control.
categories.hint.buergeramt: Local point of contact for many matters, e.g. registering your address or ID documents. Services and names differ from city to city.

categories.hint.jugendamt: Responsible for child, youth and family services.

categories.hint.krankenkasse: Statutory and private health insurers. Usually not a public authority.

categories.hint.veterinaeramt: Responsible for animal health and food inspection.

help.contact.title: More questions?
help.intro: Short answers about the main features.
help.q1.a: Tap “Near me” and allow location. Or enter a city, postcode or district under “Where?”.
help.q1.q: How do I find an office near me?
help.q10.a: No. GOVfind shows open data and is not an official source. For binding information, contact the facility. The public services hotline 115 can tell you who is responsible (Mon–Fri 8 am–6 pm).
help.q11.a: Part of the data is stored on the device. Favorites, saved data and the emergency numbers are then available. The map and map apps need internet.
help.q12.a: In the app, tap “Rate the app” under “More”. This opens the rating dialog of the App Store or Google Play. It is not available in the web version.
help.q12.q: How can I rate the app?
help.q2.a: Enter a name or type under “What?”, e.g. “Bürgeramt”, and the place under “Where?”, e.g. “Berlin”. You can also fill in just one of them. Streets and house numbers cannot be searched.
help.q2.q: How do I search for a specific facility?
help.q3.a: The data comes from OpenStreetMap. If a field is missing there, we show it as empty instead of guessing.
help.q3.q: Why does it say “No data” for some details?
help.q4.a: We only show the status when opening hours can be evaluated unambiguously. Otherwise you see the original text or “Opening hours unknown”. For important appointments, please check with the facility.
help.q4.q: Why don't I always see “Open” or “Closed”?
help.q5.a: There is no account. Favorites, notes, search history and settings are stored on your device only. If you switch devices or delete app data, they are gone.
help.q5.q: Is there an account? Where are my favorites?
help.q6.a: No. Your location is only requested when you tap and stays on your device. Details in the privacy policy.
help.q7.a: Open a facility and tap “Route”. The app shows the route on the map with time and distance for walking, driving and public transport (bus and train with the next departures). Only after you tap do start and destination go to the routing service. Alternatively open Google Maps or Apple Maps.
help.q7.q: How do I get a route?
help.q8.a: GOVfind does not store or show reviews. On the facility card, “Reviews in Google Maps” leads to Google Maps. Data is sent to Google only after you tap.
help.q9.a: Open the facility and tap “Report an error”. Corrections in OpenStreetMap help everyone who uses the data.
help.q9.q: Something is wrong or missing. What can I do?

legal.privacy.draft_marker: Draft. Legal review required before publication.
legal.privacy.s01.body: The controller is [Name], [Address], email: [E-Mail]. Data protection officer: [not appointed / contact].
legal.privacy.s01.title: Controller
legal.privacy.s02.body: No account is needed. We run no server of our own and no user database. Facility data is compiled in advance and delivered as files; search runs on your device. Favorites, notes, search history and settings stay on your device. Location is requested only after you tap and stays on your device. Our hosting provider and the map provider process your IP address when you load pages and tiles [providers]. We neither store nor show reviews; a link leads to Google Maps and data goes to Google only after you tap. No advertising, no tracking [to be confirmed]. Fonts are local.
legal.privacy.s02.title: In short
legal.privacy.s03.body: Pages and app data are delivered as static files by [hosting provider, address, server location]. The provider processes connection data (IP address, time, requested file, data volume, status code, user agent) for secure operation (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). We keep no server logs of our own. Retention is determined by the provider [details].
legal.privacy.s03.title: Hosting
legal.privacy.s04.body: Facility data is compiled in advance and loaded as files. Your search terms, filters and places are processed on your device and not sent to us or third parties. The hosting provider can see which data files are fetched.
legal.privacy.s04.title: Search and data in the app
legal.privacy.s05.body: On first start the app asks “Use your location?” in its own dialog before your device asks for permission; your choice is stored on your device only. Coordinates are processed on your device; we neither receive nor store them. The map provider can roughly infer the viewed area from tile requests, and the selected routing service receives start and destination only after you tap “Route”. Basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR); withdraw it in your device settings at any time.
legal.privacy.s05.title: Location
legal.privacy.s06.body: Your device loads map tiles directly from [provider, address]. The provider receives your IP address, the requested tiles (roughly the viewed area) and browser/app data; retention is determined by the provider. Basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The list remains usable without the map.
legal.privacy.s06.title: Map tiles
legal.privacy.s07.body:
**Route in the app:** Only after you tap “Route” on a facility (and later choose another mode of travel or tap “Later connections”), your device sends **start (your coordinates) and destination (the facility’s coordinates)** directly to the respective service; the facility’s name and address are not sent. Without your tap nothing is sent. The service technically receives your IP address and browser data (e.g. Referer = address of this app) and may keep the request in its server logs:
- **Walking and car:** routing.openstreetmap.de, operated by FOSSGIS e.V., Germany (OSRM, based on OpenStreetMap data). Privacy: fossgis.de/datenschutzerklaerung.
- **Public transport (bus and train):** Transitous (api.transitous.org, MOTIS), run by a community of volunteers [check: responsible operator, address, server location]. Privacy: transitous.org/privacy. Timetable data: transitous.org/sources.
The app keeps results only for the current session in memory. If a service does not answer or reports an error, we show the straight-line distance, which is calculated on your device. Basis: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent by granting location access and tapping “Route”).
**External map apps:** only after you tap “Open in Google Maps”, “Open in Apple Maps” or “Open in another app” does the provider receive the destination and, depending on the app, your start; its own privacy rules apply. Without your tap nothing is sent.
legal.privacy.s07.title: Routes and external map apps
legal.privacy.s08.body: GOVfind has no reviews of its own and neither stores nor shows reviews. The facility card contains an external link “Reviews in Google Maps” (marked “opens Google Maps”). Only after you tap it does Google Maps open and data (at least IP address and the search for the facility name and address) go to Google, whose rules and privacy policy apply. We receive no data from Google Maps.
legal.privacy.s08.title: Reviews of facilities (Google Maps)
legal.privacy.s09.body: “Rate the app” opens the rating dialog of the App Store or Google Play (app only). Apple or Google process your data as independent controllers. We receive no data through the app, only what the store publishes.
legal.privacy.s09.title: Rating the app in the store
legal.privacy.s10.body: The font Outfit is delivered locally. No connection to Google Fonts or other font services.
legal.privacy.s10.title: Fonts
legal.privacy.s11.body: Favorites, notes (if enabled), search history, recently viewed facilities, settings and the offline cache are stored only on your device and not sent to us. No advertising or analytics cookies [to be confirmed]. Basis: Section 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG. You can delete everything in Settings or by uninstalling the app or clearing browser data; we cannot access or restore it.
legal.privacy.s11.title: Storage on your device
legal.privacy.s12.body: OpenStreetMap links take you to openstreetmap.org (its own privacy policy applies; data goes there only after you tap). If you email us, we process your address and message to reply (Art. 6(1)(f)/(b) GDPR).
legal.privacy.s12.title: Reporting errors and contact
legal.privacy.s13.body: Links lead to facility websites, openstreetmap.org, Google Maps and other map apps. Data goes to the target only after you tap; its operator is responsible there.
legal.privacy.s13.title: External links
legal.privacy.s14.body: Recipients: hosting provider, map tile provider, FOSSGIS e.V. (routing.openstreetmap.de) and Transitous (api.transitous.org), only after you tap “Route”, and the operators of external links you open. Transfers outside the EU/EEA: [none / details]. App stores process their own data as independent controllers.
legal.privacy.s14.title: Recipients and third countries
legal.privacy.s15.body: The app requests “Location” only when you use a feature that needs it; you can change it at any time. No advertising ID, no tracking [to be confirmed].
legal.privacy.s15.title: Native apps
legal.privacy.s16.body: Hosting, tile and routing providers: as set by them [periods]. Search terms and location: not stored by us. Local data: until you delete it. Email: [period].
legal.privacy.s16.title: Retention overview
legal.privacy.s17.body: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR for hosting, tiles and offering external links; Art. 6(1)(a) for location data passed to third parties; Art. 6(1)(f)/(b) for email; Section 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG for device storage.
legal.privacy.s17.title: Legal bases
legal.privacy.s18.body: Where we process data about you, you have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection (Art. 15–18, 20, 21 GDPR) and may withdraw consent for the future (Art. 7(3)). Contact [E-Mail]. As we have no accounts or server logs, we usually only hold email correspondence. For data held by hosting, map or routing providers, Google, Apple or OpenStreetMap, contact them.
legal.privacy.s18.title: Your rights
legal.privacy.s19.body: You may lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR). Competent authority for us: [supervisory authority].
legal.privacy.s19.title: Right to complain
legal.privacy.s20.body: You are not obliged to provide data. There is no automated decision-making or profiling. Connections use HTTPS [to be confirmed]. We update this policy when the app or the law changes; the current version applies.
legal.privacy.s20.title: Further notes
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
